title: Large Language Models for Supporting Clear Writing and Detecting Spin in Randomized Controlled Trials in Oncology

live_model.evidence: Methods: 'The exact model versions were gpt-3.5-turbo-0125, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, and o1-2024-12-17. The LLMs were called via the ... API with the temperature parameter set to 1.'

prompt.location: Methods (system prompt printed verbatim with a {section} slot; user prompt = title/abstract or abstract section)

claim.metric: F1 score, positive-vs-negative trial classification, title-and-abstract input
claim.location: Table 1, 'title and abstract' block, row o1 (accuracy 0.97, precision 0.98, recall 0.97, F1 0.97 [0.95-0.99])

data.source: 250 oncology RCT abstracts with labels and code, https://github.com/windisch-paul/positive_negative

notes: o1 with reasoning costs roughly $0.05-0.1 per call; one input condition x 3 seeds is ~750 calls (borderline high). Temperature parameter is not honoured by o1, so runs should be near-deterministic apart from reasoning variance.
